parsed.note_claim: News reporting shows no evidence of fighter-jet-escorted Air India evacuations in the current Gulf crisis.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: no immediate evacuation plans have been announced due to closed airspace, with fighter jets, missiles, and drones active in the region. ... Major airlines like Air India and IndiGo have suspended flights to the region.
parsed.reason: The article confirms that no evacuation plans have been announced and that Air India has suspended flights to the region, directly supporting the note's claim that there is no evidence of fighter-jet-escorted Air India evacuations.
